payloadSchema.title: todos.status-transition@1
payloadSchema.description: One movement of a task through the machine. The exact task revision and, where applicable, the payment that caused it are declared run inputs.

notes: UI: the list checkbox (send TOGGLE), the kanban columns, and '6 Rechnungs-Todos → erledigt' in the kontoauszug intent.
trigger 'match' is what makes 'der nächste Kontoauszug hakt das Todo automatisch ab' auditable: the run names the reconciliation.match-candidate@1 that caused it.
Legal transitions are enforced by the producer's machine, not by the store. The store only records that this transition was published.
